key_insight: Lattice surgery enabled logical-state teleportation between two distance-three surface-code qubits on a 41-physical-qubit superconducting circuit.
engineering_relevance: Repeated stabilizer measurements and shorter, lower-gate-count protocols improved teleportation fidelity, informing practical logical-operation design.
method: Merge two surface-code patches using lattice surgery.
Track logical observables as information transfers from source to target.
Repeat stabilizer measurements and optimize gate count and sequence duration.
evidence_signal: The experiment observed increased teleported-state fidelity with repeated post-merge stabilizer measurements and further gains from protocol optimization; the abstract provides no numerical fidelities.
watch_item: Results at code distance three do not establish performance or resource requirements at larger, fault-tolerant computational scales.
paper_title: Teleportation of Logical Qubits using Lattice Surgery with Superconducting Circuits
